profile_text.body:
Perplexity describes itself as a free AI-powered answer engine that provides accurate, trusted, and real-time answers to any question. It was founded in 2022 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, operating as a for-profit startup.

Its products include Perplexity AI, a search-augmented LLM, and Perplexity Enterprise Pro, an enterprise search AI with internal knowledge search, data indexing, SSO, and audit logs. The company also has MCP server entries: ai.perplexity/mcp-server for real-time web search, reasoning, and research through Perplexity's API, and ai.smithery/arjunkmrm-perplexity-search, which enables AI assistants to perform web searches using Perplexity's Sonar Pro.

Court records list Perplexity AI, Inc. as a defendant in cases brought by SyteMLLabs, Sues, Gagleard, CNN, Noel, Amazon.com Services, The New York Times Company, Chicago Tribune Company, and Encyclopaedia Britannica, in federal district courts in California and New York, with an Amazon appeal in the Ninth Circuit. The records also show 281 California law exposure entries for Perplexity.
